meta.description: 웹 검색/리서치가 필요할 때 사용한다. '검색해줘', '찾아봐', '최신 정보', '이거 뭐야', '심층 조사', '자세히 알아봐', 'deep research', '전면 리서치', '자율 리서치', '조사해', 'research and plan' 같은 요청에 반드시 사용. 추가로 'X 있나?', 'X 쓸 수 있나?', 'X 풀려있어?', 'X 어떻게 쓰는지', 'X 가능한가?', '방법 있나?', 'X 살아있나?' 같은 도구·기능 존재/사용법/상태 의문문에도 사용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入问题自动联网搜索并汇总答案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要查证最新信息或在线调研。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and get concise answers to your questions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to look up up-to-date information or conduct online research.

howto.what: 装上后，当需要搜索或研究时，Claude会执行该技能：默认进行深度研究，用两个独立搜索源交叉验证并给出共识分数，输出结构化研究报告；也能快速搜索或自动生成查询并汇总。
howto.when: 当你要求“搜索一下”“查一下”“这是啥”等涉及检索、最新信息、深入调查的请求时；也用于询问某工具/功能是否存在、怎么用或状态如何时。

say.text: 搜索一下2026年实时管道架构对比
say.note: 默认深度研究，多源核对后给报告。
用单次Google搜索快速返回结果。

say.text: 自动调查一下Rust vs Go后端性能
say.note: 自动生成查询并输出结构化报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, when search/research is needed, Claude runs this skill: by default deep research with two independent search sources cross-validated and a consensus score, producing a structured report; can also do a quick search or auto-generate queries and summarize.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search, look up, check latest info, identify something, or investigate deeply; also for questions about whether a tool/feature exists, how to use it, or its status.

say_en.text: Search and compare real-time pipeline architectures in 2026.
say_en.note: Runs deep research by default with cross-validated sources.
Uses a single Google Search and returns concise results.

say_en.text: Auto-research Rust vs Go backend performance.
say_en.note: Auto-generates queries and outputs a structured report.
